schema.rule: a claim is a statement the project is prepared to make; it must cite the questions and artifacts behind it
schema.provenance_rule: every claim carries exactly one tag saying what its classification rests on, checked by benchmarks/provenance.py: ARTIFACT_READ a result the cited artifacts record, OWNER_READING the owner's reading or intention with no measurement restated here, AGENT_INFERRED an inference that may not be DEMONSTRATED or SUPPORTED, PROTOCOL_CONSTRAINT a value a registration fixes and must name
schema.engine_version: the build the claim's cited artifacts name, derived by benchmarks/provenance.py: a package version when every cited JSON artifact agrees, unattributed when they record none, document_only when the claim cites prose only; checked by check_engine_attribution

claims.claim: Organica forms developmental structure from its own event stream, with no pretrained weights.
scope_limitations: The stimulus families and world families the phases actually used.
Structure means substrate rows, edges and candidates, not semantic content.
Says nothing about external validity, task generality or capability.

claims.claim: Structure that forms persists across sleep cycles and is read back on later cycles.
scope_limitations: Persistence is measured on the substrate's own record, not against an external task.
Decay is present and was not switched off for these runs.

claims.claim: All 112 edges of the Gate-13 compositional world are present in raw temporal memory on the six measured seeds, independent of the frozen prediction cap.
scope_limitations: Presence in raw temporal memory, not selection, ranking or use in a prediction.
The asserted basis is far lower (0.2500-0.3214 on the same seeds): the world is present and the organism does not assert it, which is the finding the claim must not blur.

Re-specified 2026-11-09: the 112-edge world is the Gate-13 acquisition world, not the force-matrix world (lattice_L1, three disjoint triangles); citing force_matrix.json for this number was a mis-citation. Measured on 0.13.0 at 112 of 112 on all six seeds, so the earlier downgrade (evidence predating the rework) no longer applies to the presence half.
Promotion to SUPPORTED waits on Q002, which is still open: the measurement licenses the presence half on 0.13.0, and a load-bearing classification needs the question closed.

claims.claim: Intra-cell exclusion buys precision at the sparse end of the density ladder.
scope_limitations: The sparse end only; the dense end is pinned by the prediction cap and shows no separation.
One world family, one ordering basis.

Downgraded 2026-11-08: Q004 was reopened because the artifact it rests on (density_interaction_a2_result.json) records no engine build, so this claim now rests on an open question and may not be load-bearing. The measured value stands for the build that produced it; re-measuring on the pinned engine is what would restore the claim.

Re-measurement attempted 2026-11-09 and refused by the runner: the A1 block is held by DENSITY-INTERACTION-REVIEW-1 and a held block may not run, so no A2 number can be produced on the pinned engine until that registration is resolved.

claims.claim: Diversity-first admission improves the real engine.
scope_limitations: The pooled-edge result it was adopted on is not retracted; only the engine's benefit from it was.

Re-measurement attempted 2026-11-09 and refused: the adopted arm was withdrawn on 2026-11-07 and its module deleted, so this block exists only at `a82e890` and cannot be produced on the pinned engine at all.
claims.withdrawn_reason: The two-arm comparison on the engine's own ordering returned NO GAIN ON THIS LAYER; the adoption was withdrawn the same day and the module deleted.

claims.claim: The v1 transfer result (TR 3.2) reproduced under a preregistered protocol.
scope_limitations: No admissible test of H2 was ever run: F2 fired before the arm that would have tested it.
claims.withdrawn_reason: C1 failed as pre-registered (P2 not met) and an earlier version of the record that called it invariant was corrected; the narrower observation that survived is not a held control.

claims.claim: Role abstraction yields candidates that are reusable across worlds.
scope_limitations: Not tested. Nothing in the record supports or contradicts it yet; it is listed as a hypothesis so that it is not later quoted as a finding.

claims.claim: Schema priming speeds acquisition by raising confidence on unseen tags.
scope_limitations: The mechanism it named was replaced by a corrected account before it was tested.
claims.withdrawn_reason: Superseded by the corrected low-confidence-prior account of the same latency; the priming story was a mechanism explanation, not a measurement.

claims.claim: Transfer can be made to improve future transfer.
scope_limitations: An aim, not a result. No measurement exists, and the record contains a negative cross-domain transfer result.

claims.claim: Developmental structure improves held-out next-event prediction over the strongest simple baseline.
scope_limitations: Measured at the frozen cap on the worlds the phase used; a different readout could still find a gain.
Re-measured 2026-11-09 on the pinned 0.13.0 engine: the audit reproduces its payload exactly (headroom 0.105032, same checks) and now stamps the build that produced it.
claims.withdrawn_reason: No held-out gain was found and the interval crosses zero; the headroom against the strongest baseline was 0.005647 nats, which is a task property, not a learner's margin.

claims.claim: The architecture's stated mechanisms move development in the predicted direction.
scope_limitations: Five preregistered predictions, one developmental contrast, one noise floor.
claims.withdrawn_reason: Three of five preregistered predictions reversed in the developmental direction (contradiction +0.166, question generation +1.266, EIG +0.366, against a 0.033 noise floor).
